pr63.body:
A failed final meeting decision left an exhausted paused meeting that could not resume. The engine now closes that state with a factual saved receipt, preserves unknown usage and rejects late results; valid final speech still commits once before normal closure. The interface retains that receipt through reload and shows validation feedback for a subsequent proposal.

The qualification adds one fresh automatic activity through ordinary controls: one Start, fifteen legal synthetic decisions, six spoken turns and three speakers, followed by natural closure and an actual reload/save knowledge audit for all eight actors. A snapshot-only action preflight checks exact-candidate, auth, free-profile and independent allowance evidence without accessing services, reserving calls or granting permission.

Explicit stack: #61 -> #62 -> this PR. This draft targets #62's branch. Integrate #61 and #62 first, refresh this candidate if main changes, then require current-head Verify before integration. The original A01.1/A01.2 evidence and source ancestry are preserved. No economic rules, provider/auth configuration or save schema changes.

Local validation on Node 24.22.1:

- 1,124 script tests +55 typed; 441 overlapping town tests; 42 isolated authority/adapter tests.
- Sixteen retained-state SQL cases; integrated 42-journey meeting suite with final natural-stop and saved-reload assertions.
- Built-game and mocked-AI browser gates; four interfaces (27 desktop/29 phone checks); accessibility (54 surfaces/27 essential checks, zero violations, 19 incomplete results retained).
- Typecheck/lint (one inherited warning), diagnostics and credential-free Node/Cloudflare builds.
- Independent review of integration, natural stopping, actual saved reload knowledge and fail-closed preflight.

Current-head [Verify](https://github.com/arwyn6969/the-game/actions/runs/41301704259) passed every step at `46bbe821341448b9c68000572c093b9471b4a9af`, including the complete meeting, interface/accessibility, authenticated private-wallet and Cloudflare build gates.

Evidence: docs/review/a01-activity-2026-11-01/README.md
Hosted packet: docs/review/a01-activity-2026-11-01/hosted-trial.md

All inference is synthetic and spend is zero. No merge, deployment, production migration or real-provider/human acceptance is claimed. Current live allowance remains unverified; the preflight defaults to not-ready. Public asset GET returned 403, so the latest successful public hash evidence remains 29 October. Grok stays paused; Astra's economy design is separate.
